svg.title: A nurse is teaching a client at 30 weeks of gestation about daily self-care. Which instructions should the nurse include? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: Target intake is about 12 cups (3 L) daily, sodium is moderated rather than eliminated, and elevating the legs helps faintness. Lying flat is the dangerous distractor - she should never be supine in late pregnancy because of vena cava compression - and restricting fluids is not part of the teaching.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Physiologic & Psychological
Changes of Pregnancy
Read the situation
A nurse is teaching a client at 30 weeks
of gestation about daily self-care. Which
instructions should the nurse include?
Select all that apply.
What fits here
Drink about 12 cups, or 3 liters, of fluid
each day. · Use salt in moderation rather
than cutting it out of your diet. ·
Elevate your legs if you start to feel
faint.
Why it fits
Target intake is about 12 cups (3 L)
daily, sodium is moderated rather than
eliminated, and elevating the legs helps
faintness. Lying flat is the dangerous
distractor - she should never be supine in
late pregnancy because of vena cava
compression - and restricting fluids is
not part of the teaching.
